dedupe_keys.name: survey instruments to collect revealed and stated preferences for household adaptations unhappiness during extreme events

description: Survey Instruments to Collect Revealed and Stated Preferences for Household Adaptations & Unhappiness During Extreme Events is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Rachel Davidson, University of Delaware (udel.edu). The project contains the survey instruments used to collect and analyze household adaptations and unhappiness due to infrastructure service interruptions in different regions following various disaster events. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-35nr-pj53. Keywords: Adaptation, Unhappiness, Power Outages, Water Supply Interruptions. Published 2025-05-30. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
